stories.title: Cristobal 'beyond upset' over refs denying Canes tying TD in loss to Irish
stories.summary: Miami coach Mario Cristobal ripped officials over a call that denied the Hurricanes a game-tying score late in Saturday night's 31-24 loss to Notre Dame.

stories.title: Giants VP wowed by McCarthy, admits pre-draft concerns over QB's 'maturity'
stories.summary: Chris Mara said the Giants were concerned by J.J. McCarthy's maturity before the 2024 draft but says the QB has impressed his new team "on and off the field."

stories.title: Cowboys WR Pickens, CB Porter inactive for game against Colts
stories.summary: The Cowboys will be without wide receiver George Pickens, cornerback Joey Porter Jr. and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown against the Colts.

stories.title: Sources: Jackson told Ravens teammates he plans to return this season
stories.summary: Lamar Jackson told his Ravens teammates that he plans to return later this season, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Deion, after latest loss, not pondering job safety: 'I don't think about that'
stories.summary: Asked after a loss to Arizona State if he felt like his job was on the line, Colorado coach Deion Sanders told reporters: "I don't think about that, man. I'm not here for my job. I'm here for these young men."
